comment: OpenAI's CLIP ViT-B/32 checkpoint as transformers' CLIPModel (weights pytorch_model.bin; the repo ships no safetensors) and its tokenizer and preprocessor configs. SHA-256 of every snapshot file the harness reads (pytorch_model.bin equals the Hub's LFS hash at this revision), pinned 2026-11-06. The Hub repo has no license tag or LICENSE file; its model card is taken from openai/CLIP's model-card.md, and openai/CLIP's LICENSE (pinned below) is MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 OpenAI. The model code is transformers' modeling_clip.py at the version Forge/uv.lock pins.

upstreamCode.comment: The original release: its LICENSE (bundled) and model card (the Hub card's source). No code is imported from it.

referenceImages.comment: scikit-image v0.24.0's bundled sample images (public domain or CC0 per skimage/data/_fetchers.py), the set openai/CLIP's Interacting-with-CLIP notebook uses. Reference-case inputs only; never bundled.
